headline: Bank branches closed today under RBI calendar schedule
hook: Sixteen days of closed doors this month

modes.bear: Branch closures temporarily restrict certain high-value offline banking services and physical cash operations.
modes.bull: Digital banking usage increases during branch holidays, supporting fintech and online transaction volumes.

summary: Commercial bank branches across major institutions like SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Canara Bank, and Punjab National Bank are scheduled to remain closed on 16 days this month, factoring in regional holidays and standard weekend off days. These closures follow the official Reserve Bank of India holiday calendar for the period. Customers must rely on digital banking channels for urgent transactions during these offline closure dates. Indian retail investors and depositors should plan branch visits in advance to avoid disruption to physical banking chores.
whats_next: Next scheduled bank holiday per RBI calendar
why_it_matters: Plan physical branch visits around scheduled holiday closures.

headline: Canara Bank reports resilient gold loan portfolio with minimal delinquencies
hook: Bullion correction leaves Canara gold book unscathed

modes.bear: Further sharp drops in gold prices could eventually test the 65% LTV cushion and trigger borrower defaults.
modes.bull: Conservative 65% LTV and 0.02% delinquencies prove Canara's gold book is safely insulated from bullion price crashes.
modes.simple: Canara Bank lent money against gold safely. Even when gold prices fell, borrowers kept paying back, so the bank's money is secure.

summary: Canara Bank's Rs 2.8 lakh crore gold loan portfolio is holding strong despite a sharp correction in bullion prices, according to MD & CEO Brajesh Kumar Singh. Delinquencies remain extremely low at 0.02% with no gold auctions conducted so far. The bank's conservative 65% loan-to-value ratio is insulating the portfolio against further price drops. Indian retail investors with exposure to the bank can note that asset quality risks from gold loans appear contained for now.
why_it_matters: Low gold loan stress protects Canara Bank's asset quality and earnings.
winners_losers: Canara Bank gains / unsecured lenders hurt
